name: claude-code-extension-engineering
description: Architecture decision reference, diagnostics and behavioural-conformance tooling for Claude Code extensions. Not published to npm; installed as a Claude Code plugin or by copying the skill directory.
author: TranDenyDFW
_scriptsAreNotTheCiContract: CI runs about fifty distinct commands (.github/workflows/freshness.yml). These eight are the ones a contributor needs by hand, and they are deliberately NOT a mirror of the workflow. A duplicated list would be a second place for the truth to rot, which is the exact defect tools/coverage-report.mjs --doc-numbers exists to catch elsewhere in this repo. The workflow is the contract; read it.
_noDependencies: There are none, and that is a property worth keeping. All 78 .mjs files import node: built-ins and each other. This file exists to declare the Node floor and give `npm test` a meaning, not to add a dependency graph.
_typeModule: Set explicitly even though every source file is .mjs and is therefore ESM regardless. It is here so that a future .js file does not silently arrive as CommonJS.
